issue.description:
Verified 2026-07-30. tests/integration/fixtures/passing-suite and tests/integration/fixtures/failing-suite (added in commit d67dfa5, bf-82k4: create integration test fixture with passing and failing test suites) are committed as git submodule links (gitlink, mode 160000):

  git ls-files -s tests/integration/fixtures/
  160000 2c52c68... tests/integration/fixtures/failing-suite
  160000 c7bbce9... tests/integration/fixtures/passing-suite

There is no .gitmodules file anywhere in the repo registering these as submodules. Confirmed by fresh-clone test:  of this repo into a scratch dir leaves both directories completely empty (no Cargo.toml, no lib.rs, no .git) — git has no URL to fetch the submodule content from without a .gitmodules entry.

Impact: tests/integration.rs (the suite proving the walking-skeleton exit criterion, bf-4kw/bf-1f9/bf-1p02/bf-1ees) calls run_cargo_test("passing-suite") and depends on these fixtures containing real cargo projects. On any genuinely fresh clone — a new NEEDLE worker checkout, a CI runner, a future contributor —  will fail (fixture dirs empty) or silently no-op depending on how the test resolves the missing path. This has not been caught so far because the current checkout has uncommitted local content sitting in those directories from whenever they were first populated, and the cargo-remote shim on this box falls back to local-only execution whenever there are uncommitted changes (which this repo currently always has), so a truly clean-tree remote/CI run of this suite has apparently never happened.

This is the walking skeletons own proof-of-correctness suite for a project whose entire purpose is never losing a test result / never silently skipping — worth fixing before Phase 1a closes out further, since it undermines the credibility of every quality gates passed bead closure that depended on tests/integration.rs actually exercising these fixtures.

Fix is one of: (a) properly register them as real git submodules with a .gitmodules pointing at real remotes (probably wrong for throwaway test fixtures), (b) remove the gitlink and commit the fixture files as normal tracked files (matches how tests/fixture/ already does it — that directory IS committed as plain files, only tests/integration/fixtures/* are the broken gitlinks), or (c) generate the fixtures at test-setup time instead of committing them. Reference: tests/integration.rs top-of-file comment describing the two fixtures; tests/fixture/ for the correct committed-plain-files pattern already used elsewhere in this same repo.
issue.title: Integration test fixtures are broken git submodule links with no .gitmodules — empty dirs on fresh clone

1. Redact-before-write totality: ENFORCED. Every artifact passes the redactor before write: config.json src/crash.rs:216-223; git-state.txt src/crash.rs:228-232 (redaction applied AFTER probe assembly - load-bearing, remote get-url routinely carries userinfo); backend-STAGE.txt src/crash.rs:236-242 and stderr-STAGE.txt src/crash.rs:244-250 via redact_with_cap, which redacts first and only then keeps the tail (src/crash.rs:856-866), so a size cap can never split a live secret; events.jsonl src/crash.rs:315-324; manifest.json src/crash.rs:404-411 (caller-supplied run_id and state_dir get no free pass). Every InfraFailure tail funnels into the recorder: src/decision.rs:112 remote-verify, :204 push, :259 submit, :312 wait, :350 remote-verdict, :593 local-resolve, :636 local-spawn; src/local.rs:1036 fallback-resolve, :1075 fallback-spawn (both pass None for the raw channels). Remote stages hand over raw backend text; redaction happens at the write boundary regardless of what the caller passes.
3. URL userinfo stripped before storage or logging: ENFORCED. Single implementation src/crash.rs:598-625 (cuts through the LAST at-sign before authority end, so passwords containing at-signs do not survive as fake hosts; ports not mistaken for userinfo), applied per line to every artifact; the runlog reuses the same function in IntentRecord::new src/runlog.rs:400 (one implementation to audit, as S-5 wants) with dedicated test src/runlog.rs:753-774.
4. Scheme credentials (Bearer/Basic words): ENFORCED, src/crash.rs:629-656; ASCII-only folding keeps indexes byte-aligned on multibyte lines (regression test src/crash.rs:1148-1161).
5. Key/value secrets across JSON/TOML/YAML/env/header shapes: ENFORCED, src/crash.rs:704-778 with the secret-word table src/crash.rs:666-682 and any-segment matching (catches credential words hidden mid-key, e.g. kubeconfig client-key-data); keys survive, values become the redaction marker. issue.notes:
Ground-truth audit of committed HEAD (9d25fc6), done in a clean extraction (/var/tmp/gantry-audit-df669d5f/head, git archive; removed after success). Findings for parent bf-y1vo's README Status refresh:

1. BUILD/TESTS: cargo build --all-targets exit 0 (11.5s cold). cargo test exit 0 — 277 passed / 0 failed across 5 suites (237 unit + 18 + 12 + 6 + 4 integration; 0 doctests).

2. NO-REMOTE INTERCEPTED cargo test: NOT fixed at HEAD — still exactly the 2026-07-28 behavior. In a clean git repo with no origin, the shim intercepts 'test', decision::run_remote runs GitGate, prints "[gantry] ineligible: remote 'origin' is not configured" + "[gantry] verdict: Ineligible" and exits 1 WITHOUT compiling or running any test. Root shape: main.rs dispatches intercepted subcommands straight to run_remote; run_remote returns 1 on gate failure (its "should have been caught earlier" comment is wrong — the dispatcher does no pre-gate). No LocalExecutor exists anywhere at HEAD (systemd-run/cgroup caps appear only in doctor's probe), so the README's core claim "degrades loudly to a resource-capped local run" is false for committed code. RunLog fidelity note: the gated-out run writes only a terminal record {run_id:"ineligible", verdict:"infra_failure", ran:"local", exit_code:1} — no open intent (INV-1 gap), and ran:"local" is inaccurate since nothing ran.

3. PASSTHROUGH: (a) symlinked shim — the plan's own documented shape "[shim dir]/cargo ──symlink──► gantry" — is broken at HEAD for ALL passthrough: shim_dir() = parent of current_exe(), which resolves the symlink, so the real shim dir is never stripped from PATH; find_in_path hits the shim symlink, the self-recursion guard refuses ("gantry would re-exec itself"), exit 1 — for non-intercepted subcommands and GANTRY_LOCAL=1 alike. (b) copied shim (binary named cargo in shim dir): passthrough works — GANTRY_LOCAL=1 cargo test exec'd real cargo and ran the tests (exit 0); non-intercepted cargo --version exec'd transparently (exit 0). (c) real_binary config override bypasses PATH lookup and works with either shim shape (symlink+override verified). Caveat: at HEAD no local run is cgroup-capped — in (b) a cap existed only because the next PATH cargo happened to be the deployed bash wrapper.

4. PHASES: Phase 0 + 0.5 done (skeleton beads closed, round-trip + quality gates proven). Phase 1a mostly present on main: GitGate-with-reasons, RefPusher (epoch refs/leases/GC), write-ahead RunLog, kill switches + doctor core + <5ms passthrough all closed; config layering + last-known-good code IS in src/config.rs (bead bf-2ls still open); src/backend/{argo,command}.rs + verdict.rs exist (bead bf-23i still open, plus several open backend sub-beads). 1a acceptance NOT met at HEAD: the local half of AS-4 ("dirty repo falls back with reason") and "pod-never-scheduled falls back locally (not exit 1)" — the local-execution tail is exactly what the UNCOMMITTED WIP on this branch adds (execute_locally/run_tier0 in decision.rs, in flight by another worker). Phase 1b not started: bf-299 (semaphore), bf-xj0 (slice+GANTRY_AGENT), bf-139 (Tier-0+quickcheck), bf-3mc (flight recorder+report), why/explain --json — all open (Tier-0 exists only in the uncommitted WIP). Phase 2 (3 beads) and Phase 3 (2 beads) open, untouched.

5. 'DO NOT INSTALL ON PATH YET' CAVEAT: STILL REQUIRED. Installing gantry as the cargo shim today would (a) turn every intercepted cargo test in a non-eligible repo (no remote, dirty, non-git) into exit-1-without-running-tests — a regression vs the deployed bash pair, which degrades to a capped local run — and (b) break ALL passthrough if installed as a symlink.

No code or README changes made (verification-only bead).

issue.description:
First split child of bf-20m (plan Component 9, docs/plan/plan.md). Add a jointable module implementing:
- Key: hash over (remote_url, sha, tool, args), with sha resolved through the common git dir (git rev-parse --git-common-dir) so two worktrees of one repo compute the same key (plan EC-01).
- Store: a state dir under the gantry state root holding one flock-locked entry per in-flight key, mapping key -> RunHandle; a create-or-attach primitive reports whether the caller is originator or joiner.
- Stale handling: kernel lock release on owner death makes a dead entry detectable and reclaimable; entry removal on terminal.

Acceptance: unit tests cover key stability across two worktrees of one repo, exclusive create under concurrent contention, joiner detection while the owner lives, and stale-entry reclaim after the lock holder dies. Quality gates green on the same commit: cargo fmt --check, clippy -D warnings, cargo test.
issue.notes:
Implemented by attempt 2 (d63018d0: src/jointable.rs + pub(crate) gate::git_common_dir_in); this attempt verified it and landed it on a pushable ref.

What the module is: JoinKey = FNV-1a-64 over (repo identity, sha, tool, subcommand, args), filename-safe hex. Repo identity resolves the origin remote URL — canonical git-common-dir when no origin (EC-01) — through worktree-shared state, so two worktrees of one repo hash one key. claim() takes an exclusive flock per key under <state>/join/ and returns Originator (entry guard clears on drop, epoch-scoped by run_id so a superseded guard never touches a new claim), Attach (joiner gets the recorded RunHandle; release() reclaims the entry at terminal verdict), or Unjoined (dedup declines — submit alongside, never fail dispatch). Stale handling: handle-less entry with dead pid is taken over (kernel flock release means no dead-side code); corrupt/foreign-schema entries are parse errors, never stolen; foreign-backend entries declined; wedged live owner polls out to Unjoined.

Acceptance scenarios all pass by name: identity_and_key_are_stable_across_two_worktrees_of_one_repo + identity_falls_back_to_the_common_git_dir_without_a_remote (EC-01 key stability); concurrent_claims_admit_exactly_one_originator (8 threads, barrier); live_owner_claim_polls_until_the_handle_appears + first_claim_originates_second_attaches_third_reoriginates (joiner while owner lives); killed_lock_holders_stale_entry_is_reclaimed (real cross-process flock: spawned lock-holder child SIGKILLed, stale entry reclaimed). 16 jointable tests total.
